q: When was the three-point line introduced in the NBA?
answer:
The three-point line was officially introduced in the NBA at the start of the 1979–80 season.

* The NBA adopted the three-point arc after testing it during the preseason and having it used in the American Basketball Association prior to the ABA-NBA merger.
* Boston Celtics player Chris Ford scored the first three-pointer in NBA history during an opening-month game.
* The arc was originally set at a uniform distance from the center of the basket, including the corners.

q: Who holds the record for most points in a single NBA game?
answer:
Wilt Chamberlain holds the NBA single-game scoring record with his legendary 100-point performance for the Philadelphia Warriors against the New York Knicks on March 2, 1962.

* Chamberlain achieved the milestone on 36-of-63 shooting from the field and 28-of-32 from the free-throw line in Hershey, Pennsylvania.
* Kobe Bryant holds the second-highest scoring game in NBA history with 81 points against the Toronto Raptors on January 22, 2006.
* Chamberlain also holds the third-place spot, having scored 78 points in a triple-overtime game against the Los Angeles Lakers in 1961.
